{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out QC-failure rows (biomarker_baseline == -999)
initial_rows = len(data)
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
filtered_rows = len(data)
removed_qc_failures = initial_rows - filtered_rows

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
deduplicated_data = data.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')
removed_duplicates = len(data) - len(deduplicated_data)

# Step 3: Compute response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = deduplicated_data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Get the site with highest response rate
highest_response_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_response_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

# Print all key numbers
print(f"Initial rows: {initial_rows}")
print(f"Rows removed (biomarker_baseline == -999): {removed_qc_failures}")
print(f"Rows after QC filter: {filtered_rows}")
print(f"Rows removed (duplicates): {removed_duplicates}")
print(f"Final rows (deduplicated): {len(deduplicated_data)}")
print(f"\nResponse rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)
print(f"\nHighest response rate: {highest_response_site} ({highest_response_rate})")"}
